6c673b694fbfe881.description: ## **About Juniper Square** Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come. Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us! *Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in* [*digital-first*](https://blog.junipersquare.com/juniper-square-ponders-future-of-office-with-digital-first-hybrid-workplace-strategy/) *operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.* # **About your role** Juniper Square is the system of record for private-capital funds: we move LP capital, hold investor data our customers are legally responsible for, and enforce the boundaries between one fund’s information and another’s. We are building an in-house, three-tier Security Operations function and this role is its senior engineering presence in India. You will lead investigations, hunt for adversaries, build and validate detections, and automate the work so the team scales without scaling headcount. Working from India (Bangalore or Mumbai, or remote in India), you extend our detection and response coverage into hours when the North America team is offline, and you are a peer to the Staff Security Engineers in North America rather than a support tier for them. Our stack is already deployed: Google SecOps for SIEM, CrowdStrike for endpoint, Cloudflare Zero Trust, Upwind for cloud posture and runtime protection on AWS and Kubernetes, FireCompass for external attack surface, and a managed detection and response provider we are transitioning away from. You will report to [Director, IT — Craig Hammond; confirm] with a dotted line to the CISO, and work daily with Security Engineering, Application Security, IT, and GRC across both regions. # **What you’ll do** - Digital Forensics and Incident Response: lead complex investigations across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and SaaS environments, from initial triage and containment through root-cause analysis, remediation, recovery, and post-incident improvements. Reconstruct timelines from CrowdStrike, identity provider, Google Workspace, CloudTrail, and Kubernetes audit telemetry; preserve evidence to a defensible standard; and write post-incident reports that produce new detections and control changes. - Threat Hunting and Adversary-Informed Defense: develop intelligence-led hunting hypotheses, investigate adversary behaviors and TTPs relevant to fintech and SaaS, and use MITRE ATT&CK to identify telemetry, visibility, and security-control gaps. Convert every completed hunt into a durable detection, a telemetry request, or a documented accepted gap. - Adversary Emulation and Detection Validation: design and execute adversary-emulation exercises against our environment to evaluate detection and response effectiveness, validate security controls, identify gaps, and improve SOC and incident-response readiness. Partner with the red/purple team program and feed results into detection and hardening priorities. - Deception Technology: explore and implement deception capabilities such as decoys, honeytokens, deceptive credentials and documents, and attacker-engagement techniques to detect malicious activity early and generate actionable intelligence, with particular focus on investor data stores, payment workflows, and privileged identity paths. - Detection Engineering: build and mature our detection-as-code program in Google SecOps, improve detection coverage and fidelity, validate telemetry quality, and continuously tune detections based on investigation findings, threat hunts, and adversary-emulation outcomes. Own the detection catalog and its ATT&CK coverage map jointly with the North America team. - Security Automation and AI-Assisted Operations: automate investigation and response workflows using APIs, Python, SOAR-style tooling, and AI-powered SOC agents to reduce manual effort and improve response speed and consistency. Build enrichment, triage, and containment automations, and define where AI output is trusted, reviewed, or excluded. - Tier 2 and follow-the-sun coverage: act as the Tier 2 escalation point and senior responder during India business hours, build the playbooks and escalation criteria a Tier 1 analyst desk will operate against, and support the technical transition from the managed detection provider to in-house operations. - Telemetry and visibility: onboard and normalize new log sources, close known visibility gaps, and define what the business must log and retain for detection and audit. - Technical and Program Leadership: drive cross-functional incident response and security engineering initiatives, mentor team members in India and North America, improve operational processes, and communicate security risks and investigation findings clearly to technical and leadership stakeholders. - Evidence and metrics: contribute MTTD/MTTR, detection coverage, false-positive rate, hunt and emulation outcomes, and control test results to SOC 2 and ISO 27001, 27017, 27018, and 42001 audits and customer security reviews. - Participate in an on-call rotation for security escalations, coordinated across IST and Pacific time. # **Qualifications** - 12+ years in information security with 3+ years in detection and response, DFIR, or threat hunting roles and a track record as the senior or lead engineer on a team. - Hands-on DFIR experience: you have led investigations end to end, including endpoint and cloud forensics, timeline reconstruction, containment decisions, and clear written reporting. - Hands-on detection engineering in a modern SIEM (Google SecOps / Chronicle strongly preferred; Splunk, Sentinel, or Elastic acceptable), including writing and tuning rules, measuring detection quality, and working with ATT&CK coverage. - Experience running threat hunts and adversary-emulation or purple-team exercises, and translating their results into detections and control changes. - Strong EDR depth (CrowdStrike or equivalent) across macOS, Windows, and Linux, and working knowledge of cloud and identity telemetry (AWS CloudTrail and GuardDuty, Kubernetes audit logs, identity provider logs). - Practical programming and automation ability in Python and REST APIs; experience with detections-as-code, SOAR, or building AI-assisted investigation workflows. - Familiarity with deception techniques (honeytokens, decoys, canaries) and a point of view on where they add signal. - Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK, NIST SP 800-61, and the evidence expectations of SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audits. - Experience using AI to accelerate triage, detection development, or investigation, with clear judgment about where it should and should not be trusted. - Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to work effectively with teammates and stakeholders across India and North America time zones. - Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent experience.

6c91be8f6d96b67c.description: We are hiring a remote AI Engineer with 2 or more years of software experience to build LLM features, agent workflows and the evaluations that show they work, in client projects and our own products. ## What you will do - Build LLM features into products: drafting, summarising, pulling structured data out of messy text, and assistants that call tools. - Build agent workflows with clear limits: which tools they can use, what they may spend, and human review before anything public or irreversible. - Write evaluations: test sets built from real cases, regression checks before a prompt or model change ships, and numbers for accuracy, speed and cost. - Pick the right model for each job, route requests across providers with fallbacks, and keep costs predictable. - Use retrieval (RAG) where it helps, and say so when plain search or a simple rule would do better. - Fine-tune and run small open models when privacy or speed means the data should stay on the device. ## What we look for - 2 or more years as a software engineer, in Python or TypeScript (ideally both). - At least one LLM feature you shipped to real users, and an answer to “how did you know it worked?” - Evaluations as a habit: you measure before and after a change. - A clear view of the failure modes, such as made-up answers, prompt injection and data leaks, and designs that work around them. - Care with personal data: it goes only where it should. - Clear written English. ## Good to have - Fine-tuning (for example LoRA) - On-device inference (llama.cpp, GGUF, MLX) - Model Context Protocol (MCP) - PostgreSQL with pgvector ## How we work - **Written scope first.** Every piece of work starts with a short written scope: what ships and when. - **Weekly demos.** We show progress on a live link every week, to each other and to clients. - **A direct line.** You talk to clients and to our founder directly. There is no account layer in between. - **Remote and written.** We work remotely and write things down: decisions, handovers and runbooks. Expect a few hours a week of overlap with India time (UTC+5:30) for demos and reviews. ## How to apply Email careers@roundrobin.in with "AI Engineer" in the subject line, and send: - A link to an LLM project you built (repository, demo or write-up), and how you evaluated it. - A short note on a failure you found in an LLM system and how you fixed it. - Your CV or LinkedIn profile, your time zone, and when you could start. - **We read and reply.** We read every application and reply to each one, including when the answer is no. - **A conversation.** If there is a fit, a call of about 30 minutes about work you have done. - **A clear answer.** We decide and tell you either way.
